usage: 炸雲吞 is a noun used to refer to a specific type of deep-fried dim sum dish.
You can use 炸雲吞 in sentences when talking about food, especially when ordering or describing dishes.
炸雲吞 can be plural or singular depending on the context without changing form, like dim sum names often do.
It is commonly paired with dipping sauces, so you might see it in restaurant menus or food conversations.
You can also use 炸雲吞 to compare with other types of dim sum, especially other fried varieties.
